title: Bus Creator
text: Group input signals, buses, or messages into bus, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Number of inputs} sets the number of block inputs, {Inputs} sets the block inputs list, {Output data type} sets the data type of output bus Inherit, {Element names} sets the source of output bus element names and {Output as nonvirtual bus} sets the option to output nonvirtual bus. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input element to include in bus scalar | vector | matrix | array | bus

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output virtual or nonvirtual bus scalar | bus

params.name: Inputs
params.values: Block inputs list of element names

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output bus Inherit: auto (default) | Bus:

params.name: Element names
params.values: Source of output bus element names From inputs (default) | From output data type

params.name: Output as nonvirtual bus
params.values: Option to output nonvirtual bus off (default) | on
